intro: Ask in plain English: the AI writes the query and the chart, and you check the result before saving.
placeholder: E.g. how many outings on Tuesday evenings this season?

examples.title: Example questions:
examples.weekend: Which boats go out most at weekends?
examples.youth: How many youth rowers went out each month this season?
examples.hoursType: Hours on the water by boat type and month

history.title: Your recent questions
history.replayed: Answer from {{date}}, run again on today's data.

privacy.noNames: No people's names: the AI does not know the rowers.
privacy.line: Sent to {{provider}}: the question and the table structure, never rowers' data.
privacy.lineAssets: Sent to {{provider}}: the question, the table structure and boat and route names, never rowers' data.
privacy.lineLocal: Everything stays on this computer: the question goes to the AI server on this computer ({{host}}).
privacy.lineCopy: The copied request holds your question and the table structure, never rowers' data. You choose which AI to paste it into.
privacy.lineCopyAssets: The copied request holds your question, the table structure and boat and route names, never rowers' data. You choose which AI to paste it into.

names.found: Your question contains "{{name}}", a rower's name: it would be sent to {{provider}}. Replace it with "a rower": you will pick them afterwards in the parameters.
names.foundCopy: Your question contains "{{name}}", a rower's name: it would be copied into the request. Replace it with "a rower": you will pick them afterwards in the parameters.

status.asking: The AI is writing the query…
status.running: Checking the query on the club's data…
status.repairing: Fixing the query automatically after an error…
status.slow: This can take up to a minute.
status.slower: Still working: hard questions take longer.

answer.costTitle: Estimate based on the public price; the exact amount is on the club's {{provider}} account.
answer.repaired: Query corrected automatically after an error.
answer.inEditor: The query is loaded in the editor: check the result, then "Save" or "Pin". Nothing is saved without you.
answer.needsValues: Choose a value for {{names}} in the editor's parameters, then run the query again.
answer.notLoaded: This answer is not in the editor.

refine.label: Refine this result
refine.pasted: To refine it, tell your AI in the same conversation, then paste its new answer above.

clarification.title: The AI needs one more detail

steps.title: Use your usual AI
steps.pasteHelp: In your AI, click "Copy" under its answer (or at the top of the code block).
steps.alreadyHave: I already have an answer to paste
steps.addKey: To let the AI answer right here, add an API key:

copy.header: Request prepared by RowingBeacon for the club's statistics: the AI will answer with a code block to copy back into RowingBeacon.
copy.done: Request copied: paste it into your usual AI, then copy its answer.
copy.doneIn: Request copied: paste it into {{name}} (Ctrl + V), then copy its answer.
copy.failed: Could not copy: select all the text below and copy it.

paste.label: Paste its answer here:
paste.placeholder: Paste your AI's whole answer here
paste.invalid: This answer isn't recognised. In your AI, click "Copy" under its answer, then paste all of it here.
paste.clarification: Your AI asks for a detail: answer it in its conversation, then paste its new answer here.
paste.copyRepair: Copy the error for your AI
paste.repairCopied: Error copied: paste it into the same conversation with your AI, then paste the corrected answer here.

keyDialog.title: Set up the AI
keyDialog.saved: Key saved: you can ask the AI.

actions.copyForUsual: Copy the request for your usual AI
actions.openInEditor: Open the query in the editor

errors.invalid_key: The API key was rejected by {{provider}}: it may have been deleted, or copied incorrectly.
errors.forbidden: This key has no access to this model, or the account is out of credit. Choose another model or check the account ({{provider}}).
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests right now. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.overloaded: Overloaded right now ({{provider}}). Try again in a few minutes.
errors.bad_request: {{provider}} rejected the request. Try again; if it happens again, choose another model.
errors.network: Cannot reach {{provider}}: check the Internet connection. Without Internet, reports and the SQL editor still work.
errors.network_server: Cannot reach {{provider}}: check that the AI server is running.
errors.timeout: The AI did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.refusal: The AI declined this request. Rephrase the question.
errors.truncated: Answer too long and cut off. Ask a more specific question.
errors.repair_failed: The AI could not fix the query: {{message}}
errors.too_large: Question too long (2,000 characters at most).
errors.model_not_allowed: Model not supported. Choose a model in Management › Statistics and AI.
errors.desktop_only: The AI assistant only works in the installed application.
errors.query: The proposed query could not run: {{message}}
errors.model_not_found: Model not found ({{provider}}). Check its name in Management › Statistics and AI.
